title: Space three nap cots 3 feet apart and set the pillows head to toe
instruction: Get the nap room ready. Spread the three cots so that there are at least 114 mm (3 feet at this 1:8 scale) of floor between neighbouring cots, keeping each one flat on the green rug and pointing the way it does now, and set the pillows head to toe: one pillow on each cot, at one end of it, and no two neighbouring cots with their pillows at the same end.
context: Childcare workers (O*NET 39-9011.00) and preschool teachers (25-2011.00) set out the rest area before every nap time. Child-care licensing rules and early-care health and safety guidance ask for cots, mats or cribs to be spaced apart, most often 3 feet (some states accept 2 feet, or less with a solid barrier between), and many programs also lay the children head to toe, each child's head beside its neighbours' feet, so that sleeping children do not breathe into each other's faces; the CDC's COVID-19 guidance for child care programs also advised spacing nap mats out and placing children head to toe. Staff mark each child's head end with its pillow or blanket before the children lie down, and check the spacing with a tape or by eye. In a small rest area the 3 feet only fit with the outer cots near its edges, and the alternation is read along the whole row: moving one pillow can fix two pairs.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; the table top is the reference height. x points forward from the line through the two arm bases, y to the left of the midpoint between them, z up from the table top; the arm bases are at y +30.5 cm and y -30.5 cm. A children's nap room at 1:8 scale (114 mm here is 3 feet); the table top is its floor. Three kinds of thing are on the table. (1) Rest rug: a green carpet rug (felt or a thin carpet offcut) fixed to the table, 240 mm (along x) by 480 mm (along y) and 2 mm thick, centred at x 28.0 cm, y 0 (x 16.0 to 40.0 cm, y -24.0 to +24.0 cm); it is the rest area, and the cots must stay on it. (2) Three nap cots, all alike: loose blue rigid boxes 165 mm long, 69 mm wide and 20 mm tall, 60 g each (a stackable toddler cot about 132 x 55 cm, at 1:8; in a real build a closed box of 3 mm plywood painted blue), lying flat on the rug side by side with their long sides along x, centred at x 27.75 cm (x 19.5 to 36.0 cm) and y +12.0, 0 and -12.0 cm, so 51 mm of rug shows between neighbours. (3) Three pillows, all alike: loose white rigid blocks 30 mm (along x) by 44 mm (along y) and 12 mm thick, 12 g each (a child's pillow; in a real build white-painted hardwood), one lying flat on each cot at its far end, centred 25 mm in from that end (x 33.5 cm, at the cot's y), on the cot's top 22 mm above the table. Nothing else is on the table. A cot's near end is the end nearer the arm bases (smaller x), its far end the other one.
scoring: End state: the score is read from the cots and pillows as they lie at the last step; the cots are interchangeable, and so are the pillows. A thing is 'still' when neither its centre nor the centre of one of its end faces moved more than 2 mm over the last 0.5 s. A cot is 'set down' when it is still, lies flat on the rug (its lowest point within 3 mm of the rug's top, its broad faces within 5 degrees of level), its long side is within 15 degrees of x seen from above, and its whole outline seen from above is on the rug. A pillow is 'on' a cot when it is still, its centre seen from above is over that cot and its lowest point is within 3 mm of the cot's top, whichever face is down. A pillow on a cot marks the cot's near end when its centre is within 50 mm of the near end (measured along the cot), the far end when within 50 mm of the far end, and no end when it lies in the middle 65 mm. Score 0 if any cot is not set down (tipped, on its side, on another cot or a pillow, turned more than 15 degrees, partly off the rug, held more than 3 mm up or moving), any pillow is not on a cot (on the rug or the table, on another pillow, held more than 3 mm up or moving), or two pillows are on one cot. Otherwise take the cots in order across the rug (by y): the two neighbouring pairs are left-middle and middle-right, and each pair earns 0.25 if the clear floor between its two cots (the smallest distance between their outlines seen from above) is at least 114 mm, and 0.25 if both cots' pillows mark an end and the ends differ (one near, one far). So the score is 0.25 x (pairs spread + pairs head to toe), each count 0, 1 or 2: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 or 1.0. Every outcome: the start 0 (51 mm gaps, all pillows at the far ends); only one outer pillow moved to its cot's near end (one pair alternates) 0.25; only pillows moved so both pairs alternate (near-far-near or far-near-far) 0.5; one outer cot spread to 114 mm from the middle one, pillows all at the far ends, 0.25; one pair spread and one pair alternating 0.5; both spread, no alternation, 0.5; one pair spread and both alternating, or both spread and one pair alternating, 0.75; both spread and both alternating 1.0; a pillow left in the middle of its cot gives neither of its pairs head-to-toe credit; any zero condition above 0. Three 69 mm cots with two 114 mm gaps fill 435 mm of the rug's 480 mm, so the outer cots must go near the rug's long edges. The trial ends early once 1.0 has held for 2.5 s; otherwise it is scored as it stands at the run limit. In a real trial, tape each gap at its narrowest point, check by eye that no cot's outline crosses a rug edge, and read the pillow ends from a photo from above (a tape from the cot's end: 50 mm).
fidelity: Rigid bodies with the simulator's default friction. Cots are uniform boxes (real ones are fabric on a tube frame, about 13 cm high; here 16 cm), pillows plain rigid blocks (real ones are soft) marking each child's head end; no children, sheets or walls are modelled, and the rug's edges stand for the rest area's limits. The scorer sees only the cots and pillows, so a pillow held still within 3 mm of a cot counts as on it.
reset_notes: Lay the three cots back flat on the rug, long sides along x, centred at x 27.75 cm and y +12.0, 0 and -12.0 cm (51 mm of rug between neighbours), and one pillow flat on each cot at its far end, centred at x 33.5 cm and the cot's y. The cots are interchangeable, and so are the pillows; the rug is fixed. Nothing is consumed.
